title: Write For Us
contentHtml:
Are you passionate about sharing your knowledge and insights with a wide audience?  Reality Journal is inviting talented writers, bloggers, and industry experts to contribute to our platform. We cover a diverse range of topics, and we're always on the lookout for fresh perspectives. If you're eager to write for us, whether it's about fashion, health, business, technology, or any other engaging subject, we'd love to hear from you!

Why Write for Reality Journal?

  • Reach a Global Audience: Your articles will be read by readers from around the world who are interested in diverse topics.
  • Enhance Your Portfolio: Build your writing portfolio by getting published on a reputable platform.
  • Share Your Expertise: Provide insights and tips in your area of expertise to help others learn and grow.

Topics We Accept

We are looking for high-quality articles on the following topics:

  • Fashion Write for Us: Latest trends, style guides, fashion tips, and more. Whether you're interested in "fashion write for us" or "write for us + fashion", we welcome your unique fashion insights.
  • Health Write for Us: Wellness advice, fitness tips, nutrition, mental health, and related subjects. If you're searching for platforms to "health write for us", consider contributing to our health section.
  • Business Write for Us: Entrepreneurship, marketing strategies, industry news, and insights. Share your business acumen with our audience.
  • Technology Write for Us: Tech news, gadget reviews, software developments, and innovations. For those interested in "technology write for us" or "write for us software", we invite your technological expertise.
  • Travel Write for Us: Destination guides, travel tips, cultural experiences, and adventure stories. Share your travel tales with readers eager to explore the world.
  • Home Write for Us / Home Improvement: DIY projects, home decor ideas, renovation tips, and sustainability. If you're looking to "write for us home improvement" or "home write for us", we'd love your contributions.
  • Gaming Write for Us: Game reviews, industry news, gaming guides, and eSports. For those who want to "write for us gaming", bring your gaming knowledge to our platform.
  • Beauty Write for Us: Skincare routines, makeup tutorials, beauty product reviews, and trends. Share your beauty tips with our audience.
  • Write for Us General: We also welcome well-researched articles on other subjects that would interest our readers. If you're looking to "write for us general", feel free to pitch your ideas.
  • Write for Us Casino: Insights into the casino industry, responsible gaming, game strategies, and related topics. Share your expertise in this exciting field.
  • Write for Us Software: Software reviews, programming tips, tech tutorials, and app development. Contribute your software knowledge to our tech-savvy readers.

Guidelines for Submission

  • Original Content: Articles must be 100% original and unpublished. Plagiarized content will not be accepted.
  • Quality Writing: Ensure your article is well-written, free of grammatical errors, and provides value to readers.
  • Word Count: Preferred length is between 800 to 1,500 words.
  • Formatting: Use subheadings, bullet points, and short paragraphs to enhance readability.
  • SEO Friendly: Incorporate relevant keywords naturally into your content.
  • Images: Include high-quality images where appropriate (ensure you have the rights to use them).
  • No Promotional Content: Articles should be informative and not overly promotional.

How to Submit

Please send your article in a Word document to realityjournal.co.uk@gmail.com with the subject line "Guest Post Submission - [Your Topic]". In your email, include:

  • A brief author bio (2-3 sentences).
  • Any relevant links you'd like to include.
  • Your contact information.

Editorial Process

Our editorial team will review your submission and respond within 5 business days. We reserve the right to make minor edits to your article for clarity and SEO purposes.

Join Our Community

Become a part of the Reality Journal community and share your voice with thousands of readers. Whether you're an experienced writer or looking to build your portfolio, we welcome your contributions across various topics, including fashion, health, business, technology, travel, home improvement, gaming, beauty, software, and more.

Get in Touch

If you have any questions or need further information, feel free to contact us at realityjournal.co.uk@gmail.com
